import parse

# Check the expression generated for different formats
p = parse.Parser('<{:w}')

p = parse.Parser('^{:w}')

p = parse.Parser('{:<w}')
print(f'Inline left align regex: {p._expression!r}')

# Test matching
import re
for fmt, text in [('<{:w}', 'hello   world'), ('^{:w}', 'hello   world'), ('{:<w}', 'hello   world')]:
    p = parse.Parser(fmt)
    print(f'Format {fmt!r} -> {p._expression!r}')
    m = re.search(p._expression, text, re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
    if m:
        print(f'  Match: {m.group()!r}, groups: {m.groups()}')
    else:
        print('  No match')
